blends.name: Forgotten Shadow
blends.desc:
Forgotten Shadow (Helium) - Captures 5 souls

Legend of the Harvest Moon Rite

Under the haunting light of the Harvest Moon, an ancient, forbidden ritual unfolds: the Rite of the Lost Harvest. Only the bravest—or most reckless—dare to perform it, for it binds the restless spirits of the forgotten to the pumpkins grown in this sacred night.

These pumpkins, marked by the ritual’s shadow, become vessels for souls abandoned to time. It is said that those who possess such a pumpkin hold a key to knowledge and powers lost to mortal memory. But beware: the rite is a two-edged blade, for with this gift comes a deep, unbreakable bond to the Harvest Moon.

Few understand its origins, and fewer still survive the rite unscathed. Those who do emerge are forever marked, bearing the weight—and the secrets—of the forgotten souls within.
